title: RUST BONES: skeleton + joints + pivots. 45/π = the pivot angle.

angle.meaning: the pivot angle where rectilinear meets organic

metaphor.bone: pub mod = structural member (the rigid part)
metaphor.joint: pub trait = articulation point (where bones meet and PIVOT)
metaphor.pivot_angle: 45/π = 14.32° = the angle at which the skeleton bends
metaphor.marrow: pub fn = the marrow inside the bone (produces blood = computation)
metaphor.cartilage: pub struct = the shape that cushions the joint
metaphor.ligament: use = the connection that ties bones together across crates
